The test image shows a corn leaf with numerous small, round, dark black spots scattered across the green leaf surface — including some larger/coalescing lesions along the midrib area.

**Key observations:**
- Small, discrete, round, jet-black circular spots on a green leaf
- Spots appear raised/shiny (tar-like in appearance)
- Scattered distribution across the entire leaf blade
- Some darker elongated lesions near/on the midrib

**Comparison with reference:** The Tar spot reference collage is a near-perfect match — identical small black circular stromata (fungal structures of *Phyllachora maydis*) scattered uniformly on green corn leaves. This is the hallmark signature of Tar spot.
